pull_request.title: Calorimeter: Si-W ECAL endcap prototype
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-edge-sensors
pull_request.body:
The first nODD ECAL endcap cassette layout leaves large inner and sloping-edge regions without sensors. This isolated prototype retains the sixteen 22.5° wedge carriers of DES029’s **B — Proposed carrier approach**, places compact intact-square sensor boards inside them, and adds dedicated custom silicon masks within the same wedge boundaries.

Each wedge/layer contains **76 unchanged full-square sensors plus 36 custom inner/side sensors**, with shaped PCBs, passive guards, explicit electrodes and shared interfaces in a 120 mm outer service bay. Square-only and edge-enabled layouts share the aperture, supports and board centres; their full-face active fractions are **59.98% and 69.47%**, a 9.48 percentage-point gain. This first implementation uses individual sensor boards; grouped full/half-board engineering remains open.

A prototype 100 mm-apothem polygonal aperture with a 30 mm supported inner rim explores the requested |η| = 4 target. Full 90 mm sensors cannot fit at that radius inside a narrow wedge, so custom inner sensors are essential. Coverage remains conditional: at η = 4, 64.44% of the 360 sampled azimuths cross at least 40 of 48 layers, and zero-hit seam directions remain. These are geometric measurements, not efficiencies.

- [Single wedge before/after and inner-sensor detail (SVG)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/calorimeter-edge-sensors/docs/design/figures/DES-030/wedge-carrier-with-edge-sensors.svg)
- [Four requested coverage stages (SVG)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/calorimeter-edge-sensors/docs/design/figures/DES-030/four-stage-coverage.svg)
- [DES030 design and mask catalogue](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/calorimeter-edge-sensors/docs/design/DES-030-ecal-edge-sensors.md)
- [Native, coverage and transport evidence](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/calorimeter-edge-sensors/docs/validation/DES-030/results.md)

**Validation:** both complete 48-layer ECAL endcap layouts pass native construction, material/mass/placement checks, all sensor-volume ID round trips, all logical electrode/fragment/boundary mapping checks and full ROOT overlap checks at 10⁻⁵ mm (zero overlaps). Native material rays cover wedge centres and both sides of seams. Two seeded Geant4 custom-inner-sensor fixtures save the expected positive-energy hits on both ends. All 22 hardware controls pass; project records and documentation links are checked separately.

PR #69 and #67 are merged; this PR now targets main and preserves their records through an ordinary integration merge. No production detector integration, new external software, HCAL or barrel changes. Sensor fabrication/HV, machine aperture, mechanical/thermal/hydraulic engineering and calorimetric response remain unsigned. The prior quadrant alternative is archived and its percentages/IDs are not the wedge baseline.

events.text:
BARREL-SysArch read5664d16 and primary CALICE source under main7c6d453
instructions. Independent checks support retained sixteen-sector/48-layer
geometry, compact94 mm boards,6/7/8 columns, seven1000 mm slabs and short ends;
minimum PCB side clearance1.440 mm. A centered short grid collided with the
40 mm bay when preserving5 mm frames;5 mm inward shift leaves3 mm clearance.
359904 sensors,92135424 channels,15648 complete-lane interfaces give188.40 kW
under inherited continuous hypotheses. Headers/ports cannot be inferred from
material-filled allocations. The sector-centre eta0 ray samples only22 layers.
No native/thermal/performance qualification was supplied by that contribution.

Coordinator's aligned control exposed an entirely blind eta0.25 band. Before
extending implementation, DES031 records an unsigned physical-joint staggering
choice:alternate−96/+96 mm slab phases, retaining board count and envelope,
with276/468 mm end-slab families exchanged between ends. The central sensor row
remains present. This is a separate coordinator amendment, not an independently
reviewed SysArch conclusion. Native checks and separate PhysVal review follow.

Initial script/export failures were corrected before any scientific evidence:
a duplicated center_mm keyword prevented export; a unit test confused radial
cold-plate thickness with axial prism extrusion, and a zero-shift negative fixture
failed generic positivity before its intended bay check. The tests now check
actual radial vertices and a positive1 mm inward shift that physically overlaps
its bay. No tolerance or production input was relaxed.

All30 hardware controls pass, including eight new packing/cooling/ownership/
crack controls. The new standalone factory compiles against verified DD4hep1.38;
CMake reports upstream policy/CLHEP warnings, preserved without suppression.
No new dependencies. Native execution remains pending at this initial source
commit; results are not claimed from successful compilation.
